scope: Shared keyboard and pointer configuration authority
invariant: Unprivileged applications and broker connections cannot configure shared input devices; public static mapping reads remain available.
required_evidence: New counterexamples fail on both pre-patch servers while positive controls pass.
The patched native suites pass in Debug and native-server ASan/UBSan on both hosts.
Public mapping tables and privileged configuration controls remain real and functional.
All six configuration requests reject unprivileged callers before effects.
Both native byte orders and broker/workspace-membership denials pass.
An isolated bypass for each of the six protected requests is detected.
Locked P00-P10 tests remain unchanged and pass against the patched server.
Source and tested binary hashes match both hosts.
limitations: This component does not complete device authority, input privacy, M04, or Spatial-M1.
Actor-seat reads, application input binding, focus/pointer queries, grabs, and asynchronous metadata remain unqualified.
Native-server GLX-disabled checks do not qualify full runtime profiles or physical hardware.
